en: A monochrome illustrated postcard showing the tall tower and spire of a church rising above a dense cluster of old town roofs. The tower has arched windows and an open belfry with a steep spire. At the top left, in Gothic-style script, is the title "Trinitatiskirche." At the bottom left, framed in a small box, is the word "Mitau." A small artist's signature appears in the upper right border.
